description: The top 15 of a division: the Boxerbook rating (default) or the latest list of a publisher (WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring, TBRB), with records. Division by code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's flyweight). Pound for pound: division p4p (or "pound for pound", pfp) gives the Boxerbook P4P top 25 of men, w_p4p (or "women's p4p") the top 15 of women, ranked by the Boxerbook rating (mu − 2·rd measured against the elite of the boxer's division; active within 18 months, 10+ bouts, 2+ quality wins in 36 months); only Boxerbook has a P4P list, no publisher's is stored. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

publisher.description: boxerbook (the Boxerbook rating), wbc, wba, ibf, wbo, ring or tbrb
